collection.description: An exhausted parent speaks too harshly to a child who spilled water.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (parent), an exhausted parent, speaks too harshly to (child), who spilled water.

choices.label: Explain the Stress Without Excusing the Tone
Wait Until Both Are Calm to Discuss It

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (child) relaxes after hearing a sincere apology.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) remains upset and asks for some quiet.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) understands (parent) was tired but still wants gentler words.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (parent) notices the explanation sounded like an excuse and corrects it.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Cleaning together turns into a small joke about the spill.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) stays quiet, and (parent) checks in later.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The delayed apology feels more thoughtful to (child).

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) says the apology matters but needs time to feel better.
